description: Partial Pi extension dependency fix for goal and loop

userStories.title: Update goal and loop packages
userStories.description: As an operator, I want compatible goal and loop packages so that their host-dependency warnings disappear.
acceptanceCriteria: Review published source and dependency manifests for `@narumitw/pi-goal@0.54.8` and `@trevonistrevon/pi-loop@0.7.15` against the installed Pi version.
Verify that both candidates declare host packages as wildcard peers rather than runtime dependencies.
Change the exact-pin test first and record its failure against the original settings.
Update only the goal and loop pins in `.pi/settings.json` and its exact-pin test.
Leave subagents, tasks, and all unrelated settings unchanged.
Document reconciliation and the two remaining upstream warnings in `docs/harnesses/pi.md`.
Add an issue-linked changelog entry under `Unreleased`.
The focused settings test and repository lint, typecheck, build, and tests pass.
userStories.notes: Executed: focused exact-pin red test exit 1 before settings changes, green 4 tests exit 0 afterward; inspected implementation diff confirms only goal/loop pins changed. Published manifests and sources reviewed in manual-review.md; advisor reran real Pi 1.0.2 runtime verification exit 0. Worker lint/typecheck/build/test exit 0 (1851 passed, 2 skipped). Documentation and issue-linked changelog inspected. Reasoned: unrelated settings and subagents/tasks remain byte-equivalent by diff.

userStories.title: Record isolated runtime verification
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want isolated runtime evidence so that warning removal does not conceal missing extension capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Start after US-001 implementation; use disposable sandbox package and runtime state.
Record clean installation and reconciliation from the original goal and loop versions.
Record the installed Pi version, exact commands, outputs, and exit statuses in `.agro/tasks/pi-extension-issues/evidence/manual-review.md`.
Confirm that the original manifests trigger the reported host-dependency condition and that both candidate manifests avoid it.
Load both candidates through Pi and confirm that their goal and monitor/loop tools and commands register without extension load errors.
Exercise bounded goal state transitions and a harmless monitor command without a paid model call.
Clean up disposable resources; leave the current Pi session and global installation unchanged.
Fill the PR manual-review section from observed evidence, including the original failure case.
userStories.notes: Executed: advisor reran timeout 180 node evidence/runtime-check.mjs exit 0: original warnings reproduced, clean and reconciled candidate loads have errors=[] and warnings=[], retained tools/commands register, active/paused/clear goal transitions and monitor printf command complete successfully, disposable state removed. CLI update skips exact pins; resource reload performs reconciliation. Manual-review evidence inspected; no model calls/global changes. PR manual-review section derived from these observed results.
